title: Cypher Defense
tagline: Cypher Defense is a distributed solution to protect you against scam and phishing in Web3. Keeping your Coins and NFTs safe in your wallet!
description:
Web3 and the Creator Economy is about to fall into the chasm and not reach the early majority audience. This is largely attributed to scams and phishing attacks. A lot of these phishing attacks are targeted at impersonating female influencers.

This is a project to help protect all web3 enthusiasts from the prevalent scams, impersonation and phishing attacks that are happening in the Web3 space
how_its_made:
Its basically a chrome extension that modifies the behavior of your browser when it detects there is a fraud in the associated DApp

We basically utilize Regex style pattern recognition to detect for fraud in the DApp

We also utilize social network mechanism crowd source these blacklistings
